name: antigravity-autoaccept
description: IPC integration skill for AntiGravity AutoAccept VS Code extension (yazanbaker.antigravity-autoaccept). Eliminates CDP WebSocket contention between LazyGravity Go bot and AutoAccept by exposing a local HTTP bridge on :27182. v2.0.0 adds 8 verified gotchas and 5 lessons learned from production experience.
author: WJ

antigravity-autoaccept.description: Guides setup of the IPC HTTP server inside the AutoAccept extension and the corresponding Go client, resolving CDP port contention on :9222/:9333 when LazyGravity and AutoAccept run simultaneously. Includes verified gotchas (ipcEval timeout bug, startup race, double-check layer) and lessons learned.
